subject: CAIQ mapping intake — Solstice Systems audit sequencing and artifacts
messages:
From: Aisha R. <security@solstice-systems.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice CAIQ intake — initial questions & timeline

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this on — our audit team at Solstice is working with external assessors and they asked us to start a CAIQ control mapping with Redwood this week. Attached is a first-pass spreadsheet of our questions and the controls we think will be in-scope (Solstice_CAIQ_Questions_v1.xlsx).

Open items we need from Redwood for the initial readout:
- Control narratives or brief statements for the indicated controls
- Runtime telemetry/log samples for a 48-hour window (anonymized is fine)
- Architecture diagram showing tenant boundaries and network segmentation
- Approximate delivery timeline (our external assessor arrives Sept 20)

Can you confirm a single point of contact and whether Redwood can commit to an initial artifact bundle by Sept 10? If not, please advise an earliest feasible milestone.

Also note: Solstice scope includes EU data for a subset of tenants — we'll flag controls where residency matters separately in the sheet.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Security, Solstice Systems
security@solstice-systems.com

Attachment: Solstice_CAIQ_Questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34 KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aisha R. <security@solstice-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solstice CAIQ intake — initial questions & timeline

Hi Aisha — thanks for the worksheet and the heads-up about the assessor window. Markus here (Security & Compliance at Redwood).

We can support the CAIQ intake and I propose the following lightweight plan so we give the assessor a coherent bundle by Sept 17 and an internal artifact sprint to meet your Sept 10 checkpoint:

1) Scope confirmation (by Sept 4): Redwood to confirm tenant scope (production vs. scoped demo tenants) and residency flags. Please mark rows in your sheet that are EU-only controls.
2) Internal artifact sprint (Sept 8–10): our control owners will pull narratives, diagrams and a 48-hour log sample.
3) Draft response bundle (Sept 13): we deliver a draft PDF bundle and attachments for your review.
4) Finalized artifacts (Sept 17): updated bundle delivered to your assessor.

Deliverables we expect to provide to Solstice: concise control narratives, architecture diagram, anonymized runtime telemetry sample, relevant config snapshots and pointers to existing SOC2 reports (redacted as needed).

Two quick clarifications:
- Can you confirm whether the auditor needs raw logs or a summarized sample? Full raw logs may require additional redaction steps.
- Do you want the artifacts uploaded to the Google Drive link in your template or via DocuSign/evidence portal?

If that plan works I can kick off an internal sprint this morning and loop our owners. Would you like a short call today (30 min) to walk the sheet?

Regards,
Markus Klein
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Solstice CAIQ intake — owners & timeline

Kimberly / Marissa — quick intake and owners for Solstice. Aisha (Solstice Security) opened the CAIQ worksheet and we committed to a short sprint. Key points below; need your confirmations by EOD Sept 3 so we can hold the Sept 8–10 sprint.

Context (from Aisha): auditor on-site Sept 20–24, Solstice flags some EU-residency rows.

Owners & asks:
- Kimberly Park — runtime telemetry sample & log redaction (48-hour window, anonymized). Deliverable: runtime-telemetry-sample.txt. Due: Sept 10 (first pass).
- Marissa Cole — control narratives & artifact assembly (control-by-control PDF bundle). Deliverable: CAIQ_Solstice_Responses_DRAFT.pdf + attachment manifest. Due: Sept 13 (draft).
- Markus (me) — scope confirmation and intake coordination with Solstice; I will confirm the upload link and shepherd the final delivery.

Dependencies and notes:
- If EU residency controls require additional data handling proofs (e.g., EU-only keystore screenshots), flag immediately.
- Kimberly: please include the KV-cache isolation note where relevant (Q: which controls reference tenant-level eviction?).
- Marissa: include a short summary of which SOC2 sections map to CAIQ claims to speed the assessor.

Please reply-all with any blockers. If either of you foresee needing infra assistance to pull log samples, start a ticket with infra and tag "solstice-caiq" so we can escalate.

Thanks — I’ll confirm the upload link once Solstice replies.

— Markus
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha R. <security@solstice-systems.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2027 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice CAIQ artifacts — draft bundle and upload link

Aisha — attaching our initial artifact bundle and a couple of supporting files. Thanks for the patience while we pulled samples.

Deliverables in this draft package (attached):
- CAIQ_Solstice_Responses_DRAFT.pdf — control narratives and per-control evidence pointers (PDF, 18 pages)
- service-architecture-diagram.pdf — annotated diagram with tenant boundaries and segmentation
- runtime-telemetry-sample.txt — anonymized 48-hour sample (tokenized IDs and IPs removed)

Notes / clarifications:
- The telemetry slice is anonymized. If the assessor needs additional fields we can expand the output but may need to schedule a secure transfer (SFTP) for raw artifacts.
- EU-residency controls: we added a short attachment list for EU-only artifacts. If Solstice confirms which tenant IDs are in scope we will swap in the region-specific screenshots by Sept 15.
- SOC2 reference: within the draft PDF you'll find a mapping appendix linking the most relevant SOC2 sections to CAIQ claims to speed review.

Upload link for full evidence set: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-solstice-evidence (we've granted view/comment access to audit.team@solstice-systems.com). Please let us know if your assessor needs different access.

If you'd like a walkthrough of the bundle, Markus and I can join a 30-minute call early next week.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Principal Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: CAIQ_Solstice_Responses_DRAFT.pdf, service-architecture-diagram.pdf, runtime-telemetry-sample.txt
